offering_description.value: Marten Transport hauls temperature-controlled and dry freight for manufacturers, distributors, and retailers. It operates truckload and dedicated fleets and arranges shipments through third-party carriers.

primary_services.value: Temperature-controlled truckload hauling; dedicated fleet operations; dry-van truckload hauling; freight brokerage

customer_segment.value: B2B: Food and beverage producers, consumer goods manufacturers, distributors, and retailers

end_markets.value: Food and beverage; grocery retail; consumer packaged goods; general merchandise retail

revenue_model.value: service fees: Truckload transportation and freight arranged through third-party carriers; project or contract: Dedicated fleet capacity and operations under shipper contracts

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Operates tractors and refrigerated and dry trailers to haul freight for commercial shippers; service provider: Sources capacity from third-party carriers and arranges shipments for commercial shippers

geography_served.value: North America: United States and cross-border freight service with Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: Refrigerated and dry truckload hauling, dedicated fleets, and freight brokerage

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Shipper contracts and direct freight bookings with commercial accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FMCSA rules on motor carrier safety, driver qualifications, and hours of service

notes: The current relative scale of truckload and dedicated operations is uncertain.
